nodes.description: Caf1-55 is the Drosophila ortholog of RBBP7, 96% identical at the amino acid level. Germline-specific knockdown (nos-GAL4) depletes germ cells and severely shrinks the testis, whereas somatic cyst-cell-specific knockdown (tj-GAL4) causes hyperproliferative, tumor-like cyst cells instead. Ectopic wild-type human RBBP7 rescues the male infertility caused by Caf1-55 deficiency; mutant human RBBP7 does not.

nodes.description: In Drosophila, somatic cyst-cell-specific (rather than germline) knockdown of RBBP7/Caf1-55 causes hyperproliferative, tumor-like accumulation of cyst cells with elevated DNA double-strand breaks.
